title: KTR Crowns Rebrands and Launches New Website
html:
Dental offices can size, order and restock pediatric zirconia and stainless steel crowns for primary teeth in one place at ktrcrowns.com.

KTR Crowns, a supplier of preformed dental crowns for primary teeth, has rebranded and moved its full catalog to a new website at ktrcrowns.com. The name behind the letters is now spelled out as Kids Tooth Restoration, and the crowns remain unchanged: the same pediatric zirconia and stainless steel crowns, sizes, and labeling that dental offices already order.

The new site was built around how a dental team actually orders. Practices that previously purchased KTR crowns through Pediatric Dental Resource (PDR) can now order directly at ktrcrowns.com, with access to account pricing, order history, and downloadable invoices. Single refill crowns can be ordered by tooth, size, and fit profile with no minimum order, and orders placed before 3:00 PM PT ship the same business day.

For offices comparing crown systems, the site puts the clinical material up front:

  • CrownView, a visual size selector for KTR zirconia crowns
  • Step-by-step preparation guides for anterior and posterior zirconia crowns, with video
  • Sizing charts for zirconia and stainless steel crowns
  • Instructions for use, catalogs, and downloadable order forms
  • Free samples for dental professionals who want to try the crowns before ordering

KTR pediatric zirconia crowns come in three fit profiles: Standard, Slim (1 mm narrower mesiodistally, for space loss), and Mini (1 mm shorter occlusocervically, for short clinical crowns or limited clearance). Starter kits include colored zirconia try-on crowns so the final crown stays clean until cementation. KTR stainless steel crowns are made of medical-grade stainless steel and arrive pretrimmed and precrimped. They are available in starter kits, refill boxes, and a full 48-box refill set.

The new logo carries over the teal of Pediatric Dental Resource, which many practices already know, and replaces the plus sign of the old purple-and-black logo with a smiling face. The story behind it is available on the KTR blog at ktrcrowns.com/resources/blog/meet-the-new-ktr-logo.

Dental offices can browse the catalog at ktrcrowns.com/shop or request free samples at ktrcrowns.com/free-sample.

About KTR Crowns

KTR Crowns (Kids Tooth Restoration) supplies preformed zirconia and stainless steel crowns for primary teeth to pediatric and general dental practices in the United States and Canada. The company is based in Las Vegas, Nevada.
